PART III — LANDS
Land Acquisition Notices
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7

My Ref. No. : NCP/TK/9/11/LC/08-11 Land Ministry’s Ref. No. : 4-3/7/2016/HW/349 I, hereby give notice under Sub-Section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act that the Government intends to acquire the under-mentioned lands which are required for a public purpose. Description of lands to be acquired: The allotments of land described below are in extent of 15.5642 Hectares depicted from Lot Nos.842 to 909 (Lot Nos. 68) in the Sheet No. 79 in the Supplement No. 76, in the Final Colony Plan No. PO 34 dated 22.02.2018 prepared by the Senior Superintendent of Survey of the Polonnaruwa District for the Surveyor-General located in the village of Kaduruwela in the Grama Niladhari’s Divisions of No.162 Weera Pedesa, No. 163 Pulathisi Pedesa and No. 183 Kaduruwla West in the Meda Pattuwa Minor Division in the Thamankaduwa Divisional Secretary’s Division in the District of Polonnaruwa in the North Central Province and bounded.

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7

My Ref. No. : NCP/TK/9/11/LC/08-11. Land Ministry’s Ref. No. : 4-3/7/2016/HW/349. I, hereby give notice under Sub-Section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act that the Government intends to acquire the under-mentioned lands which are required for a public purpose
